text_block_list.text:
Though she doesn't win, Эйсин Флэш
becomes the
center of the older racers'
attention and feels
confident about
beginning her senior year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just when Эйсин Флэш realizes that
completing
her schedule is within the
realm of possibility, she
receives a
message from her parents.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They tell her they're planning to visit
Japan to see
her race in person. She is
overjoyed by the news
and vows to win
every race leading up to their
visit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho becomes her
ultimate goal
since that's when her
parents will be in Japan. But
first, there's
the Osaka Hai to contend with.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, I can't help but feel unnerved
by how
many established racers are
returning to the
scene to race in the G1
races...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
